title: Former Lockheed/CIA contractor: EG&G scientists in private Utah labs

tellings.quote: 2001, a former Lockheed and CIA contractor went public saying that Loheed is working on UFO technology and that scientists contracted with EG&G were organizing work in private labs in Utah.

plain: In 2001, a former contractor for Lockheed, the aerospace company, and for the CIA is said to have gone public claiming that Lockheed was working on UFO technology and that scientists contracted with EG&G, a company that ran secret government test work, were organising the work in private labs in Utah. Michels tells this himself, without naming the contractor or a source. If true, it would mean such work was spread out into private hands, away from government sites.
